title: Vegan Poke Bowl
description: A refreshing and healthy poke bowl made with marinated tofu and mixed vegetables, served over a bed of quinoa.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm, drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
In a medium bowl, whisk together agave, lime juice, and a pinch of salt.
Add the cubed tofu to the marinade and toss to coat.
Let the tofu marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, marinated tofu, chopped poke, and sliced red onions.
Toss gently to combine and serve immediately.
